target.title: fix(agents): honor Anthropic Retry-After in auto-retry backoff (#103849)
target.body:
﻿## What Problem This Solves

On the default Anthropic Messages transport (used by `anthropic-messages` models), a 429 response carrying a server-specified `Retry-After` header lost its HTTP status and cooldown metadata before the agent retry/failover owner saw it. The embedded runner could therefore retry or rotate profiles inside a still-active provider cooldown, including shortening a provider-requested 120-second window to the normal first auth-profile cooldown.

Closes #103849

## Why This Change Was Made

The managed transport already parses provider HTTP responses, but the thrown error did not preserve `httpStatus` / `retryAfterSeconds` through `extractTransportErrorDetails` into `AssistantMessage`. OpenClaw's supported embedded-runner path also disables `AgentSession` auto-retry and owns retry/failover in `run.ts`, so the server cooldown has to reach the embedded runner and auth-profile cooldown state, not only the session inner loop.

## Changes

- `src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.ts` attaches structured HTTP status and canonical Retry-After parsing to non-OK Anthropic Messages errors.
- `src/agents/transport-stream-shared.ts` preserves `httpStatus` and `retryAfterSeconds`, including overflow `Infinity`, on assistant errors.
- `packages/llm-core/src/types.ts` adds optional `AssistantMessage.httpStatus` / `retryAfterSeconds` metadata.
- `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/assistant-failover.ts` routes short Retry-After windows into same-model rate-limit retry and routes over-limit windows into auth-profile failure marking.
- `src/agents/auth-profiles/usage.ts` keeps rate-limited profiles unavailable for at least the server Retry-After window while preserving existing `cooldownReason`, `cooldownModel`, and failure-count semantics.
- `src/agents/sessions/agent-session.ts` keeps the same structured metadata usable for the non-default session auto-retry path without making it the supported OpenClaw retry owner.

## User Impact

Anthropic 429s with a short Retry-After now wait out the provider's cooldown before retrying the same model. Longer provider cooldowns no longer collapse to the default 30-second profile cooldown; the profile stays unavailable for the server-requested window and the runner proceeds through the existing fallback/rotation path instead of hammering a still-rate-limited profile.

## Evidence

Current head: `cc968b5a6a`.

Red/green proof for the latest review finding:
- Before the fix, `markAuthProfileFailure(... retryAfterSeconds: 120)` produced `cooldownUntil = now + 30_000`; after the fix it produces `now + 120_000`.
- Before the fix, embedded failover marked the failed profile without `retryAfterSeconds`; after the fix it passes `retryAfterSeconds: 120` into auth-profile failure marking.

Focused current-head proof:
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/assistant-failover.test.ts -t "Retry-After"` -> 12 passed / 58 skipped
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/auth-profiles/usage.test.ts -t "per-model cooldown metadata"` -> 14 passed / 146 skipped
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run.incomplete-turn.test.ts -t "structured Retry-After"` -> 4 passed / 236 skipped
- `cmd /c node_modules\.bin\oxfmt --check --threads=1 ...touched files...` -> pass
- `git diff --check` -> pass

Earlier transport/parser proof on this PR:
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/transport-stream-shared.test.ts -t "propagates httpStatus"` -> 2 passed / 24 skipped
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.test.ts -t "surfaces HTTP status and Retry-After"` -> 2 passed / 216 skipped
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.test.ts -t "over-limit Retry-After"` -> 2 passed / 216 skipped
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/provider-transport-fetch.test.ts -t "retry-after"` -> 58 passed / 134 skipped
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/llm/utils/retry.auto-retry-delay.test.ts -t "server Retry-After"` -> 4 passed / 3 skipped

GitHub CI is retriggered for the latest pushed head.
